<svg width="0" height="0" style="position:absolute" aria-hidden="true">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="g-alu" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f4f4f4"/><stop offset=".55" stop-color="#dcdddf"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#c6c8cb"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="g-steel" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#e9eaec"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#cdd0d3"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#b4b8bc"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="g-chrome" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#fafafa"/><stop offset=".45" stop-color="#bfc2c6"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#8d9196"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="g-dark" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#3a3a3a"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#161616"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="g-screen" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#2a2e33"/><stop offset=".4" stop-color="#15181b"/><stop offset=".42" stop-color="#1c2024"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#0d0f11"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="g-lens" cx=".35" cy=".35" r=".7">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#6c7480"/><stop offset=".35" stop-color="#1b1f26"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#050505"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="g-holo" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#e6e9ee"/><stop offset=".3" stop-color="#d9d2e3"/><stop offset=".6" stop-color="#d3e2e2"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ece6d8"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="g-scr-on" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#f4f7ff"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#cfdcfb"/></linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="g-hdd" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#eef0f2"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#dcdfe3"/></linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="g-cup" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#4a4a4a"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#2c2c2c"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#1c1c1c"/></linearGradient>
    <pattern id="p-mesh" width="7" height="7" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <circle cx="3.5" cy="3.5" r="1.4" fill="#0b0b0b"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>
</svg>
